newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece sets selling commissions on 3/5/7-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Greece sets selling commissions on 3/5/7-yr bonds.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry said in a statement that selling commissions on three-, five- and seven-year fixed coupon bonds to be auctioned on March 19 would be 0.60 percent, 0.95 percent and 1.10 percent respectively.
Coupons on three-, five- and seven-year bonds have been set at 9.8 percent, 9.2 percent and 8.9 percent respectively.

The ministry will auction 150 billion drachmas of three-year bonds, 100 billion of five-year bonds and 50 billion of seven-year bonds on March 19. Issue date is March 21. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
